hazards.evidence: Large pile of clothes/blankets plus shoes and bags sitting in the main walking area; a walker cannot pass through the center of the room.
Round pet bed, pet bowl and a bone/toy on the floor in the foreground walkway.
Large loose area rug/mat over the wood floor in the main path, with its edge and piled items creating a trip catch for a walker.
Room is dim (ceiling pendant off, only one small table lamp) while strong sunlight through the right doorway creates glare and deep shadows that hide floor edges and clutter.
Unmarked threshold/level change at the right-hand doorway, hard to see because of the bright glare across the floor.
